citation.title: Systematic evaluation of the effect of multi-ion-source neutral beam injection on motional Stark effect diagnostic in KSTAR
citation.authors: Lee, Youngho; Ko, Jinseok; Na, Yong-Su

topic: Offline correction of MSE pitch-angle systematic offsets from spectral overlap of multiple KSTAR NBI sources
own_question: Can measured Stokes parameters plus model equations separate NB1-A from NB1-B MSE contributions and estimate the time-varying polarization-angle offset?
actual_method_and_evidence: Intensity ratio kappa is estimated from Q/U changes at a manually chosen beam turn-on. Gradient-descent least squares fits a tanh+linear pitch-angle profile per time slice. The method is applied to #26068 and thirteen 2020-campaign discharges. Measured and modeled U/Q are compared. True pitch angles are not independently verified, and the authors list this verification as future work. No CES, Ti, BES/ECEI or nowcasting content.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: In KSTAR, beam-emission spectral overlap from multiple NBI sources can bias spectroscopic beam-based measurements (MSE), depending on beam energy combinations.
claim_checks.qualification: MSE polarimetry only. The finding does not transfer to CES Ti. The offset estimates are model-based and unverified, and the source uses the 2020 campaign, not 2022.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Offline post-processing with 20 ms averaging. No online timing reported.
validation_if_relevant: Self-consistency of U/Q fit only. There is no independent truth or held-out data.
forbidden_inferences: CES carbon Ti suffers the same quantified offset
Modeled angles are validated physical truth
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Different diagnostic and question. Cite only if the paper discusses NBI-dependent beam-spectroscopy systematics in KSTAR; otherwise exclude.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
